candidates.change_summary: Change support check to only return true for IAccessControl interface (remove IERC165 support), so supportsInterface reports false for IERC165.
Invert the comparison so supportsInterface returns true when interfaceId is not IERC165, changing many results.
Always return false, making supportsInterface report unsupported for every interface.
Always return true, making supportsInterface report supported for every interface id.
Change hasRole to return the negation of the stored mapping value (i.e., invert result), so callers observe opposite truth value.
Change hasRole to always return true regardless of stored mapping, making every account appear to have any role.
Change hasRole to always return false regardless of stored mapping, making no account appear to have any role.
Change hasRole to return whether account equals the zero address instead of checking mapping, so only the zero address appears to have roles.
Change hasRole to return whether account equals the contract address instead of checking mapping, so only the contract itself appears to have roles.
